title: Image feed adds authenticated listeners
summary:
The image feed gained authenticated access, while the community project directory grew and its featured listings got tidier.

Authenticated image-feed listeners can receive the full event stream, including saved events replayed on connection. Listeners without authentication retain the existing content filters.

The project list gained chat tools, interactive stories, image generators, a picture-book plugin, social bots, and MVKProject Nexus API, which combines multi-model chat with Pollinations-powered images and image analysis.

KoboldAI moved into the featured projects and to the top of its tools list, with corrected links and creator attribution. Featured-project sorting now respects an explicit first-place position, limits each category to five entries, and marks newly added projects.
